svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Rule Chain execution, fan-out, retry and hot reload

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Rule Chain execution, fan-out, retry and hot reload
Runtime: producer and local single-target path
Multi-target fan-out creates independent Queue records
copy target + new UUID, producer send
Parent completion waits for child enqueue only.
Each child is later consumed with a new pack callback.
Already enqueued siblings are not rolled back.
Retry cannot undo completed database or external effects.
RETRY_ALL may repeat records already reported successful.
Main Queue default SKIP_ALL_FAILURES commits failures/timeouts.
Control plane: metadata transaction then Actor hot reload
BEGIN; replace nodes / relations / first node
broadcast lifecycle UPDATED per RE service
PostgreSQL commit and notification send are not one transaction.
HTTP success does not prove every service has reloaded the graph.
